title: Time Commando
overview:
Your objective: become a computer technician of the future and repair the cores of 8 eras in history. A 3D fighting action game that stands out for its unprecedented camerawork and scrolling. With more than 45 types of weapons and over 80 kinds of enemies, it offers plenty of challenge!!

目的は未来のコンピュータ技術者となり、歴史上の8つの時代のコアを修復すること。従来にないカメラワークとスクロールが注目の3D格闘アクションゲーム。武器45種類以上、敵も80種以上と手応え十分!!
